## Describe your changes

Please provide a summary of the changes made and the problem being solved. Include any relevant motivation, context, and structural design choices.

## Issue ticket number (if applicable)

Fixes # (issue number)

## Checklist before requesting a review
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have compiled my Python changes using `python3 -m py_compile` to ensure no syntax errors.
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally on my machine.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md` or `architecture.md`) if my changes introduce new config values, workflows, or parameters.
- [ ] My commits follow the Conventional Commits specification.
